en_title: Xbox Announces New XP Entertainment Division to Make Movies, TV, and More
cn_title: XBOX新设XP部门拓展娱乐业务
subtitle: 不止于游戏
opus_summary: 微软成立XP娱乐部门，由原Mojang总裁Kayleen Walters领导。部门涵盖影视、周边、品牌合作及线下体验，但不直接制作，而是寻找合作伙伴。

paragraphs.en: Xbox has announced a new TV, movies, and entertainment division called XP. It will be headed up by Kayleen Walters, a Lucasfilm veteran who moves over from her most recent post as president of Minecraft maker Mojang, where she also served as an executive producer on last year's A Minecraft Movie.
paragraphs.cn: XBOX宣布成立名为XP的新部门，负责电视、电影及娱乐业务。该部门将由曾在Lucasfilm任职多年的Kayleen Walters领导。她此前担任《我的世界》开发商Mojang的总裁，任职期间还担任了去年上映的《我的世界大电影》的执行制片人。

paragraphs.en: XP brings together four "areas of investment": Xbox Pictures; Xbox Products; Xbox Partnerships; and Xbox Places. Microsoft said XP was set up to help Xbox become the number one entertainment and gaming company in the world, which requires broadening its big franchises beyond video games themselves. But it is not a production company. Rather, Microsoft wants to find the right partners to work across film, TV, physical experiences, and consumer products.
paragraphs.cn: XP整合了四大「投入领域」：XBOX Pictures、XBOX Products、XBOX Partnerships和XBOX Places。微软表示，成立XP是为了帮助XBOX成为全球第一的娱乐与游戏公司，而实现这一目标需要让旗下大型系列走出电子游戏本身。不过，XP并不是制作公司；微软希望寻找合适的合作伙伴，在电影、电视、线下体验及消费产品领域展开合作。

paragraphs.en: Microsoft has already seen significant success in the movie and TV space, with Warner Bros.' A Minecraft Movie breaking box office records, and Amazon's Fallout TV show setting records for Prime Video. Upcoming Xbox adaptations include movie sequel Minecraft Squared, Fallout Season 3, a Call of Duty movie with Peter Berg and Taylor Sheridan, and a Diablo animated series with Netflix . Microsoft's deal for Hideo Kojima's Metal Gear Solid spiritual successor Physint includes film and TV rights, so expect an adaptation of that eventually.
paragraphs.cn: 微软在影视领域已经取得了显著成功：华纳兄弟的《我的世界大电影》打破了票房纪录，亚马逊的《辐射》剧集也创下了Prime Video的纪录。即将推出的XBOX改编作品包括电影续作《Minecraft Squared》、《辐射》第三季、Peter Berg和Taylor Sheridan参与的《使命召唤》电影，以及与Netflix合作的《暗黑破坏神》动画剧集。小岛秀夫的《Physint》是《潜龙谍影》的精神续作，微软就该作签订的协议包含影视改编权，因此可以期待它最终也会推出改编作品。

paragraphs.en: XP is also about live events, and again, Xbox already has success there. Blizzard's BlizzCon saw a number of significant announcements , with 35,000 people at the physical event in Anaheim, California, and 12.5 million watching at home. The most recent Minecraft Live , which saw the announcement of the first new dimension for Minecraft in 14 years, reached more than 144 million people.
paragraphs.cn: XP还负责现场活动，而XBOX在这方面同样已有成功经验。暴雪在暴雪嘉年华上公布了多项重要消息，35,000人来到加利福尼亚州阿纳海姆的活动现场，另有1,250万人在家观看。最近一次《我的世界》直播活动宣布了该作14年来的首个新维度，触达人数超过1.44亿。

paragraphs.en: Meanwhile, Microsoft cited partnerships such as Gears of War's takeover with WWE, and Xbox's range of Ikea furniture . A Minecraft theme park is set to open its gates next year .
paragraphs.cn: 此外，微软还列举了《战争机器》与WWE的联动，以及XBOX与宜家合作推出的家具系列等合作项目。《我的世界》主题乐园计划于明年开门迎客。

paragraphs.en: "XP was created from a simple but powerful belief: the world's most beloved gaming franchises have an opportunity to reach people far beyond the boundaries of the game itself," Walters said. "Fans don't just play our franchises. They watch them, wear them, attend them, celebrate them, and connect with them in countless ways. XP brings together the teams responsible for helping Xbox franchises show up in the world in bigger, more meaningful ways."
paragraphs.cn: Walters表示：「XP的成立源于一个简单却有力量的信念：世界上最受喜爱的游戏系列，有机会突破游戏本身的边界，触达更多人。粉丝不只是玩我们的游戏。他们还会观看改编作品、穿戴周边、参加相关活动、为这些系列庆祝，并以无数种方式与它们建立联系。XP汇集了相关团队，帮助XBOX旗下系列以更广泛、更有意义的方式走进人们的生活。」

paragraphs.en: "XP is a play on 'Experience Points' and formalizes four investment areas for us: Xbox Pictures for film and television adaptations; Xbox Products for licensing and merchandise; Xbox Partnerships for sponsors and brand partners; and Xbox Places for our marquee broadcast and in-person events, theme parks, and other location-based experiences," Xbox CEO Asha Sharma wrote in a company-wide memo also posted to Xbox Wire.
paragraphs.cn: XBOX首席执行官Asha Sharma在一份发给全公司的备忘录中写道：「XP这个名字借用了经验值（Experience Points）的概念，也正式确立了我们的四大投入领域：XBOX Pictures负责影视改编；XBOX Products负责授权与周边商品；XBOX Partnerships负责赞助商和品牌合作；XBOX Places负责我们的重磅直播及线下活动、主题乐园，以及其他依托实体场所的体验。」这份备忘录也发布在了XBOX Wire上。

paragraphs.en: "Our franchises can mean more to people than the time they spend playing them, and Kayleen knows how to build those experiences with the industry without losing what made people care about the franchise in the first place."
paragraphs.cn: 「我们的系列带给人们的意义，可以超越他们花在游戏上的时间。Kayleen知道如何与业界合作打造这些体验，同时保留最初让人们喜爱这些系列的核心。」

paragraphs.en: Microsoft noted the uplift its video games can get when movies and shows do well. For example, Fallout games on Game Pass saw a 5x increase in hours played during Fallout Season 1. Minecraft, meanwhile, saw over a 75% increase in weekly active users year-over-year since the movie released (as of April 30, 2026).
paragraphs.cn: 微软指出，影视作品取得成功也能带动旗下电子游戏的表现。例如，《辐射》第一季播出期间，XBOX Game Pass上的《辐射》游戏游玩时长增至原来的5倍。而自电影上映以来，《我的世界》的周活跃用户数同比增长超过75％，这一数据截至2026年4月30日。

paragraphs.en: If this sounds a bit familiar, it's because Microsoft has tried this before. In 2012 (back in the Xbox 360 era!), Microsoft announced Xbox Entertainment Studios with an aim to produce TV shows that would air directly on Xbox consoles. XES revealed plans to create shows based on Gears of War, Fable, Forza, and State of Decay — not to mention, of course, the original version of the Halo TV show announced at E3 by Stephen Spielberg , who was set to executive produce. They even planned to make an unscripted street-soccer drama called Every Street United. The entire XES effort lasted just two years before getting shut down as the Xbox One's "all in one" message failed to resonate with gamers following its reveal in 2013.
paragraphs.cn: 如果这听起来有些熟悉，那是因为微软以前就尝试过。2012年——那还是XBOX 360时代！——微软宣布成立XBOX Entertainment Studios，目标是制作直接在XBOX主机上播出的电视节目。XES曾公布计划，为《战争机器》《神鬼寓言》《极限竞速》和《腐烂国度》制作剧集。当然，还有斯蒂芬·斯皮尔伯格在E3上宣布的最初版《光环》剧集，他原定担任执行制片人。他们甚至计划制作一部名为《Every Street United》的无剧本街头足球节目。XBOX One在2013年公布后，其「一体化」宣传理念未能引起玩家共鸣，整个XES项目仅持续了两年便被关闭。

paragraphs.en: As part of the changes, Mojang has a new boss. Maria Angelidou-Smith, who joins Xbox as CEO of Mojang, spent nearly a decade at Meta working on Facebook Groups before stints at Personio and Reddit, where she was Chief Product Officer. "She has built products used by billions of people and led product and engineering organizations through significant growth and change," Sharma said.
paragraphs.cn: 作为此次调整的一部分，Mojang也迎来了新负责人。Maria Angelidou-Smith加入XBOX，担任Mojang首席执行官。她曾在Meta工作近十年，负责Facebook Groups，随后先后任职于Personio和Reddit，并在Reddit担任首席产品官。Sharma表示：「她打造过数十亿人使用的产品，也带领产品和工程团队经历了大规模增长与变革。」

paragraphs.en: "She will bring that experience to Mojang while learning from the people who know Minecraft best. Her first order of business is for her to learn from the teams and communities that make Minecraft so special."
paragraphs.cn: 「她将把这些经验带到Mojang，同时向最了解《我的世界》的人学习。她上任后的首要任务，是向那些让《我的世界》如此特别的团队和社区学习。」

paragraphs.en: Minecraft is, of course, one of the big Xbox franchises the company is doubling down on amid Sharma's ongoing "Reset," which has seen nearly 2,000 staff cut from the gaming business so far this financial year. Minecraft is the best-selling video game of all time, having shifted over 425 million copies. Its significant merchandising business became one of the top 20 globally.
paragraphs.cn: 当然，在Sharma持续推进「重置」的过程中，《我的世界》是XBOX正在加大投入的主要系列之一。本财年至今，这轮调整已使游戏业务裁员近2,000人。《我的世界》累计销量超过4.25亿份，是史上最畅销的电子游戏。其规模庞大的周边商品业务也已跻身全球前20。

paragraphs.en: Ryan McCaffrey is IGN's executive editor of previews and host of IGN's weekly Xbox show, Podcast Unlocked , and a co-host of Next-Gen Console Watch . He's a North Jersey guy, so it's "Taylor ham," not "pork roll." Debate it with him on Twitter at @DMC_Ryan .
paragraphs.cn: Ryan McCaffrey是IGN预览报道的执行编辑，也是IGN每周XBOX节目《Podcast Unlocked》的主持人及《Next-Gen Console Watch》的联合主持人。他来自新泽西州北部，所以他管那种食品叫「Taylor ham」，而不是「pork roll」。你可以在X上通过@DMC_Ryan与他辩论这个问题。
